t: This Lexco Tania fixed fire rated LED downlight provides efficient and safe illumination for various indoor settings. It features an integrated 6W LED, delivering 600 lumens, and is fire rated for 30, 60, and 90 minutes, ensuring safety. The white twist-lock bezel offers a clean finish, ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, and commercial spaces. Electricians will appreciate the detachable driver with lever connectors for straightforward wiring and the CCT adjustable switch, allowing selection of 2700K, 4000K, or 6000K white light. This dimmable downlight is also IP65 rated, making it suitable for bathroom zone 2 installations.
